question.worked_solution:
We have $\frac{3}{20}$ on the left and $\frac{15}{20}$ on the right.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14129810/assets/a9d43ba0a45ea09cca23c929380f4c97a7e28ef959f04701236b9696163f26e7.png)

The shape on the left has $3$ shaded pieces, and the shape on the right has $15$ shaded pieces. So, the number of shaded pieces has increased by a factor of $5.$

Therefore, the multiplication problem shown is

$$
\frac{3}{20}\times 5=\frac{15}{20}.
$$

So, the missing number is $5.$
